scientific_integrity: Two independent exhaustive cycle enumerations and independent aperiodic correlation formulas agree; code is included and was executed. All numeric claims are integer exact. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact computational classification only of all cyclic binary order-five de Bruijn cycles and their 32 linear cuts; does not establish higher-order formulas, periodic-correlation spectra, or historical uniqueness.
title: Exact phase-dependent aperiodic sidelobe spectra of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
